evidence_quotes:
USAGE: Transmission
(4L80-E)
FLUID/LUBRICANT: Dexron
® III only
(Do not use Dexron® II)
CAPACITIES: Dry: 13.5 qt (12.8L)
Drain & Refill 7.7 qt (7.3 L)
EXPECTED TEMPERATURE: All Temperatures
Except Arctic
statements.reason: The lubrication table specifies Dexron III only outside arctic conditions and explicitly excludes Dexron II.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, Dexron® II may not be used in the 4L80-E transmission.

statements.reason: The unqualified claim overlooks the instruction to use OEA in arctic conditions.
statements.statement: The manual allows only Dexron® III in the 4L80-E transmission.

evidence_quotes:
Use only Dexron®
III for 4L80-E transmission. Failure to
use only Dexron® III for 4L80E
transmission will cause damage to
transmission.
statements.reason: The manual warns that failing to use only Dexron III will cause transmission damage.
statements.statement: Using Dexron® II in the 4L80-E transmission will damage the transmission.

evidence_quotes:
Use Dexron® II for filling transfer
case. Failure to use Dexron® II
will cause damage to transfer case.
statements.reason: The transfer-case instruction specifies Dexron II without a transmission-type condition.
statements.statement: The manual specifies Dexron® II for transfer-case filling regardless of transmission type.

evidence_quotes:
Use Dexron® II for filling transfer
case. Failure to use Dexron® II
will cause damage to transfer case.
statements.reason: It specifies Dexron II for transfer-case filling without an arctic-only restriction.
statements.statement: The manual does not restrict transfer-case use of Dexron® II to arctic conditions.

evidence_quotes:
Fill transfer case (model 218) with
3.5 quarts (3.3 L) of Dexron® II.
statements.reason: The stated fill amount is unconditional, so it applies on level ground.
statements.statement: On level ground, the model 218 transfer case should be filled with 3.5 quarts (3.3 L).

evidence_quotes:
Fill transfer case (model 242) with
3.35 quarts (3.17 L) of Dexron® II.
statements.reason: The stated fill amount is unconditional, so it applies on level ground.
statements.statement: On level ground, the model 242 transfer case should be filled with 3.35 quarts (3.17 L).
